_comment: The software and reference table for the About sheet, kept as data rather than markup
so the page and the repository's own THIRD_PARTY record cannot drift apart.
stage is where the tool sits in the pipeline: precompute runs on the Mac and never
ships; browser is vendored and served from this app's own origin.
statement: Every molecule on this site is drawn from its SMILES with RDKit. Every structure is rendered from coordinates fetched from the RCSB PDB. Every piece of narrative is written fresh. No publisher figure, graphical abstract or full text is reproduced here: abstracts are quoted verbatim in a marked quotation block with their citation and DOI, which is ordinary scholarly quotation. The graphical abstract strip in the Campaign drawer is an original interactive re-creation drawn from SMILES, not a copy of the published image.

pipeline.label: Extract
pipeline.detail: Text and page images out of the PDF. The SAR tables in all four papers are images with no text layer, so their numbers are read by eye and typed into the raw files by hand.

pipeline.label: Curate
pipeline.detail: One hand-checked file per published table, each carrying the table it came from. This is the source of truth and nothing downstream may contradict it.

pipeline.label: Chemistry
pipeline.detail: Descriptors, the campaign scaffold, core-aligned depictions, and the verification ladder: deposited ligand, published name through OPSIN, or fragment assembly on a verified core.

pipeline.label: Structure
pipeline.detail: Coordinates from RCSB, secondary structure from DSSP, pocket numbering from KLIFS where the target is a kinase, and protein-ligand contacts from PLIP.

pipeline.label: Bundle
pipeline.detail: The wide published tables melted into long-format measurements, one row per compound per assay, so four papers with different assay panels share one shell.

pipeline.label: Dynamics
pipeline.detail: A short molecular dynamics run per primary structure, used to test the paper's own claim about a contact rather than to illustrate it. A trajectory that does not support what the paper says is not published.

pipeline.label: Validate
pipeline.detail: Schema, provenance, chemistry and cross-reference gates. A measurement with no source table fails the build, as does a residue cited by an edit that does not exist in the structure it is cited against.

software.name: RDKit
software.role: Descriptors, maximum common substructure, core-aligned depictions, fragment assembly with molzip

software.name: OPSIN
software.role: Parsing the papers' own IUPAC names into structures, to verify every hand-built SMILES by connectivity rather than by formula

software.name: PLIP
software.role: Protein-ligand interaction profiling: every distance drawn in the app comes from here
software.licence: GPL-2.0, invoked as a subprocess and never imported

software.name: DSSP
software.role: Secondary structure assignment, collapsed to helix, strand and loop

software.name: Open Babel
software.licence: GPL-2.0, reached only inside the PLIP subprocess

software.name: PyMOL
software.role: The downloadable script, session and still image for each structure
software.licence: Open-Source PyMOL licence (BSD-style), invoked as a subprocess

software.name: pypdfium2
software.role: Text and page images out of the paper PDFs, on the Mac only; nothing it produces enters the repository

software.name: OpenMM
software.role: The molecular dynamics engine for the short per-structure runs
software.licence: LGPL-3.0-or-later, run under a separate interpreter as a subprocess and never imported

software.name: OpenFF Toolkit
software.role: Ligand parameters from the Open Force Field small-molecule force field, with AM1-BCC charges

software.name: PDBFixer
software.role: Missing atoms and loops rebuilt, and protonation set, before solvation

software.name: MDTraj
software.role: Trajectory analysis: per-residue RMSF, ligand RMSD against the crystal pose, and contact occupancy per frame
software.licence: LGPL-2.1-or-later, run under a separate interpreter as a subprocess and never imported

software.name: Mol*
software.role: The structure viewer, including the camera-locked twin view

software.name: Plotly.js
software.role: Every figure, on one shared template; the basic partial bundle, fetched on first use

software.name: RDKit.js
software.role: Depiction and changed-atom highlighting in the page

data_sources.name: RCSB PDB
data_sources.role: Every coordinate file in this app is fetched from RCSB at view time. None is redistributed here.

data_sources.name: KLIFS
data_sources.role: Kinase pocket numbering: the 1 to 85 positions and their region labels, per structure

data_sources.name: PubChem
data_sources.role: Structures for the approved comparator drugs, checked against each paper's published formula
